notes:
T295 — acceptance runner PATH fix + smoke staleness ruling.

Root cause: managent initialized Threaded IO with an empty environment (InitOptions.environ defaults to .empty). All child processes spawned via std.process.run (acceptance runner, git commands, claimlint) inherited an empty environment block — no PATH, no HOME, nothing. /bin/sh started (absolute path) but sh's child 'zig' couldn't be found. Same for git in deliverableVerdict (silent failure → treated as 'not a git repo' → skipped deliverable checks entirely).

Fix: pass init.environ (from std.process.Init.Minimal) to Threaded.init. One-line change at main.zig line 140. This inherits the full parent environment for all spawned children.

Additionally:
— Distinguish acceptance failure modes: CANNOT RUN (exit 127/126, spawn failure, signal) vs ACCEPTANCE FAILED (exit code) — the former is labelled 'infrastructure fault', not a task failure.
— Audit ski-acceptance uses: managent audit now surfaces every done task with skip_acceptance_reason set (WARN level).
— Regression controls added: checks 14-16 in tools/regression-managent-integrity.sh cover nonexistent acceptance command → CANNOT RUN, failing command → ACCEPTANCE FAILED, audit surfacing skip-acceptance.
— Integrity test repaired: git init instead of touch .git (the old binary silently skipped deliverable checks because git was not on PATH).

§5 smoke staleness ruling: chose option 3 — report staleness as STALE (not FAIL). A stale bin/ is NOT VERIFIED, not BROKEN. The suite exits 0 when the only issue is staleness. Missing/wrong-tool/unverifiable binaries still FAIL. Rationale: a build.zig-only commit that changes no binary content (e.g. adding a test step) need not redden the suite for 380/380 passing tests. The loud STALE message plus the fix command ('zig build deploy') is sufficient. The property from T289 (genuinely stale → visible) is preserved — stale binaries print STALE with the fix command.

Could not establish: whether the old binary's deliverableVerdict was silently skipped (git not on PATH → spawn failure → gitOk false → REJECTED 'cannot ask git') or whether there was another reason the integrity test passed before. The git init fix makes it moot — the guard now works correctly either way.

Next: deploy to bin/ (done in this session); let the Orchestrator verify the acceptance runner on a real task.
